registry.description: Evil is the most comprehensive negative moral category in Scripture — covering everything from individual acts of harm and injustice to the systemic moral disorder of a world turned away from God. The Hebrew vocabulary spans harmful, wicked, bad, and injurious; the Greek picks up the same range. Evil is not primarily an abstract philosophical problem in Scripture but a concrete reality: things done, words spoken, patterns established that damage what God made good. It is also attributed to spiritual beings, not only to human choices.

terms.medium_def:
People from Repha(?), first mentioned at Gen.14.5; 
referred to as Rephaim (רְפָאִים), or Zamzummin (זַמְזֻמִּים). § the Ammonite name for the people who by others were called Rephaim, and were described as a numerous nation of giants; perhaps the same as 'Zuzim'
